behaviours.statement: the recorder writes a frame only when the picture changed, and the driver repeats frames to fill the grid: a large fraction of the frames in the file are byte-identical to their predecessor
behaviours.provenance: measured over the corpus's sessions; the room map reports 85,306 of 127,527 frames as repeats

behaviours.statement: a CHANGED frame differs from its predecessor by about 1.15 luma on average over the whole frame; below that, the change is the sensor's own noise and not the person
behaviours.provenance: measured over the corpus's sessions; the room map's per-pixel motion noise sigma is 0.61 luma per change

behaviours.statement: every frame in a session can be byte-identical to every other frame: the camera delivered nothing while the audio layer was alive
